title: How marketing feeds the pipeline
caption: Marketing fills the pipeline, and sales works it.
figure: A marketing funnel drops three inbound leads into the Lead in stage of the deal board.

customers-do-not-arrive-on-their-own.header: Customers do not arrive on their own
customers-do-not-arrive-on-their-own.description: “You can’t wait for users to come to you. You have to go out and get them”; getting users is a gradual process.[1]

do-things-that-dont-scale.title: Paul Graham, Do Things that Don't Scale

volume.title: Volume
volume.keywords: funnel, many people at once, a few raise a hand, high volume, small yield
volume.script: Marketing works like a funnel. It speaks to many people at once, and a few of them raise a hand. High volume, small yield. That is how it is supposed to work.

enter-a-defined-stage.title: Enter a defined stage
enter-a-defined-stage.keywords: a lead, not a customer, inbound lead, sales makes contact, fills and works
enter-a-defined-stage.script: A person who raises a hand does not become a customer. They become a lead in one defined stage of your pipeline, for example an inbound lead. Only then does sales make contact. Marketing fills the pipeline, and sales works it.

you-do-not-need-it-first.title: You do not need it first
you-do-not-need-it-first.keywords: no campaign first, no budget, network and phone, first contact this week
you-do-not-need-it-first.script: So do not park your first task behind a campaign. You have no budget and no audience yet. You do have a network and a phone. Make your first contact this week, and let the funnel come later.
